reason: The simpler setup and the client pages sound good, and I might start the free trial. But nothing here says my clients and freelancers can get in without a paid seat, and that's the reason I'd switch, so I'm not paying for it on this pitch.
objection: Per-seat pricing with no mention of free guest access. If every contractor and client reviewer costs $15 a month, I'm back to paying for a tool I resent, just with fewer features.
would_change_my_mind: A clear line saying clients and contractors get free guest access to their project or client page, so I only pay for my core team.
